fnol_text: My name is Tariq Petrov and I live at 39 Thornbury Lane, Fairview, PA 16425. You can reach me on (555) 408-7678 or tariq.petrov@example.com. On 12 September 2024 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Rafael Thorne, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2024-00052. adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Petrov on (555) 408-7678 to acknowledge the claim. Tariq confirmed the loss date as 12 September 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Nikhil Whitfield gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Rafael Thorne reports minor burns to the hand and attended Mercy General. Tariq reports lower back strain.
